notes.title: Missing Exe?
notes.content:
Hello Everyone, Q here
We recived news that users with x86 repositorys couldn't start the game because of the missing exe file.
This was due to a certain steam configuration that only allowed the download on x64 repositorys.

We deeply apologize for this inconvinience.

An update has been released that fixes this issue. We hope all of you can enjoy the game without further worries.

Sincerly, LimitBreakersTM team.
